title: V-STaR: Benchmarking Video-LLMs on Video Spatio-Temporal Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using a Reverse Spatio-Temporal Reasoning (RSTR) task that requires them to explicitly ground their answers temporally ('when') and spatially ('where') to reveal if correct answers ('what') are generated from true spatio-temporal understanding or merely rely on pre-trained statistical priors and dataset memory.
